archetypes.name: sentinel-ordering
archetypes.rationale: Each folded write must land after source-env but before pause-check; this ordering invariant is the primary failure mode and is not fully covered by generic edge or correctness profiles.
archetypes.prompt_body: The plan folds roughly 14 sentinel writes into host fences with a critical invariant: each colon-redirection to DESIGN_TMPDIR/.completed/<N> must appear after the source-env line and before the pause-check (design-pause-save.sh) in each host fence. For each fold site described in plan items 5, 7, 8, 10, 11, 14, 15, 17, and 19, verify the plan placement description is unambiguous and that no interleaved conditional branch, subshell, or variable assignment could push a write past the pause-check. Pay special attention to the Step 2a four-sentinel batch write relative to read-design-classification.sh and the SIMPLE guard, and to the Step 5c conditional write gated on PLAN_WRITE_OK=true. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: resume-routing-audit
archetypes.rationale: The discussion-block fold creates a new pause-resume contract where four sentinels batch-write at Step 2a, whose correctness depends on the 1d.7 router and design-pause-save routing that the static panel does not trace.
archetypes.prompt_body: The plan claims that a pause taken mid-discussion is honored at the Step 2a entry fence, that the four discussion sentinels are written before the pause-check in that fence, and that resume routes forward via the 1d.7 router through the .outline-approved file to Step 2a without re-running any completed discussion step. Verify these claims by reading the existing pause-save and resume routing logic in skills/design/SKILL.md, design-pause-save.sh, design-pause-load.sh, and step-name-registry.tsv. Check whether the joint presence of the four batch-written sentinels and the .outline-approved file is sufficient for the 1d.7 router to advance to Step 2a, or whether any sentinel is consumed by a guard that could re-trigger the discussion block. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: test-harness-gaps
archetypes.rationale: The plan extends test-design-structure.sh with new assertions that reuse extract_first_bash_fence_after; unverified helper semantics or missing fold-site coverage would silently weaken the regression net.
archetypes.prompt_body: The plan proposes a new assert_folded_sentinel_writes check and a deleted-prelude guard in scripts/test-design-structure.sh, both reusing the extract_first_bash_fence_after helper. Verify that this helper exists in the current script and that its anchor-matching semantics using step-comment patterns like step:2a are consistent with each of the 14 proposed call sites. Check that every fold site named in the plan appears in the proposed assertion coverage, that the write-before-pause-check ordering assertion is structurally sound for fences where the pause-check appears inside a conditional, and that the deleted-prelude guard pattern matching timing-ledger.sh is specific enough not to false-positive on legitimate surviving timing-ledger calls in the 1c through 2a region. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
